meta.description: Local-first, provenance-preserving normalization of generated raster logo candidates into validated SVG brand assets and editable descriptor variants.
meta.author: brandonz@heritagehill.co
meta.boundary: Canonical post-generation brand-asset normalization stack. It accepts explicit local raster/SVG paths, performs deterministic local transforms, and returns provenance; it does not generate images, choose canonical geometry, install fonts, edit business repositories, or publish assets.
meta.mcpSafety: Source files must be regular non-symlink local files under 50 MB for raster intake and 10 MB for SVG input. Outputs are explicit .svg paths with a JSON provenance sidecar and are never overwritten unless overwrite=true. Subprocesses use argument arrays without a shell. SVG scripts, external references, data URLs, and unsafe embeds are rejected.
